reply_text: The current workflow for Casted Heat By-products in the CCM system does not support retroactive entry or editing without first mandating a full reversal of the original booked production. To enable the desired functionality, a workflow enhancement is required by the CCM engineering team.
problem_summary: User requires a mechanism to retroactively add/edit by-products for casted heats that were initially missed, without forcing a full reversal of booked production.
findings: Current system workflow for CCM does not allow for retroactive entry of by-products for casted heats without first reversing the initial booked production. This is a functional gap, not a data integrity issue.
root_cause: CCM system workflow design mandates production reversal for edits/retroactive entries.
resolution: Requires workflow enhancement/business logic change in the CCM system.
